sources.angle: Connect the earlier nighttime visit with bringing myrrh and aloes for Jesus’s burial to identify Nicodemus. Ask about the named person rather than a weight, and distinguish him from Joseph of Arimathaea, who asks Pilate for the body.

Connect absence from the earlier visit with the request to see nail marks and the later invitation to inspect Jesus’s hands and side, identifying Thomas. Do not claim that he actually touched Jesus; the excerpt records an invitation, not its acceptance.

Connect the eloquent Alexandrian teacher with Priscilla and Aquila explaining the way more accurately to identify Apollos. Do not identify a modern ethnicity or portray his earlier teaching as wholly false.
